evals.prompt: Review this diff: a new function `get_email(user_id)` in `users/lookup.py` that calls `db.find_user(user_id)` (documented as returning Optional[User]) and immediately returns `user.email` without any None check. Ask for a review of the working tree changes.
evals.expected_output: The null-safety bug is reported at confidence >= 90 with file:line and a concrete fix; a code-review.md tracker is created; verdict line is REVIEW NEEDS FIXES.
expectations: agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md is created with a timestamp header and an Issues Tracker table
The missing None check on the Optional return is reported with confidence >= 90
The report ends with the exact verdict line '🔄 REVIEW NEEDS FIXES' including the open-issue count
No issues outside the diff are flagged

evals.prompt: Review a diff that only renames a local variable and updates its three usages in one function, with no behavior change.
evals.expected_output: No fabricated findings. The review reports clean and ends with the REVIEW SATISFIED verdict line.
expectations: No issue is reported at confidence >= 80 (nothing is invented to look thorough)
The report ends with the exact verdict line '✅ REVIEW SATISFIED — no open issues at confidence ≥ 80.'
agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md is still written/updated with Overall: Clean

evals.prompt: A previous review left agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md with CR-1 open (missing None check in users/lookup.py:12). The diff now contains the fix (early return when user is None). Re-run the review.
evals.expected_output: Incremental re-run: CR-1 is re-checked against the new diff and flipped to Fixed; no duplicate CR id is created; verdict is SATISFIED if nothing new.
expectations: CR-1 keeps its ID and is marked ✅ Fixed rather than re-reported as a new issue
The re-run passes only the current open-issue list to the review agents, not prior passes' full reports
The tracker's Created timestamp is preserved and Last Updated is bumped

evals.prompt: First-ever review of the working tree in a repo with no agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md yet. HEAD is abc1234.
evals.expected_output: The tracker is created with the commit-anchor frontmatter fields populated for a full first run.
expectations: The tracker frontmatter contains Reviewed-Commit: abc1234 (the actual HEAD short hash, obtained via git rev-parse --short HEAD)
Reviewed-Commit-Previous is set to 'none'
Review-Scope is set to 'full'
The report header states the scope as a full diff and gives the commit hash

evals.prompt: agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md exists with Reviewed-Commit: abc1234. Two commits have landed since (HEAD is now def5678) touching only payments/refund.py. The earlier-reviewed file auth/login.py is unchanged since abc1234 but contains a bare `except:` that the prior review deliberately did not flag. Re-run the review with no extra arguments.
evals.expected_output: Gap-only review: the new-issue scan covers abc1234..HEAD, auth/login.py is not re-scanned, and the tracker records the new anchor.
expectations: Reviewed-Commit is read from the existing tracker frontmatter before any review agent is launched
The diff handed to the review agents is git diff abc1234..HEAD (plus unstaged changes), not the full branch diff
No new issue is raised against auth/login.py, since it is outside the gap
On write, Reviewed-Commit becomes def5678, Reviewed-Commit-Previous becomes abc1234, and Review-Scope is 'gap'
The report header states the scope as gap abc1234..def5678

evals.prompt: agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md exists with Reviewed-Commit: abc1234 and open issues CR-1 and CR-2. The user asks: 'review the whole branch from scratch, ignore the previous review'.
evals.expected_output: Explicit full re-review: the recorded commit is overridden as a base, but the existing issue IDs are preserved.
expectations: The entire diff is scanned, not just abc1234..HEAD
Review-Scope is written as 'full' and the output says the gap base was overridden at the user's request
CR-1 and CR-2 keep their IDs and are re-checked — the tracker is not reset to a fresh CR-1
Reviewed-Commit is still updated to the current HEAD

evals.prompt: agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md records Reviewed-Commit: abc1234, but the branch was force-pushed and that hash no longer exists in the repo. Re-run the review with no extra arguments.
evals.expected_output: Graceful fallback to a full review, explicitly stated — no crash, no silent empty gap.
expectations: The existence of the recorded hash is verified (e.g. git cat-file -e abc1234^{commit}) before it is used as a diff base
The run falls back to reviewing the full diff with Review-Scope: full
The output states that the recorded base no longer resolves and why the review is full
The run does not error out or report an empty diff as 'nothing to review'

evals.prompt: agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.md records Reviewed-Commit equal to the current HEAD, the working tree is clean, and CR-1 is still ❌ Open. Re-run the review.
evals.expected_output: No gap to scan: the run re-verifies the open issue and reports that there is nothing new, without inventing findings.
expectations: The run reports that there is no gap since the last review rather than stopping with 'nothing to review'
CR-1 is still re-checked against the working tree and gets an explicit verdict
No new issues are fabricated and no new CR id is created
The verdict line reflects CR-1's real state (NEEDS FIXES while it remains open)

evals.prompt: Review PR #430 (review only). The diff has two real bugs. After the report is written, the Stop hook fires: 'cr: agent-spec/<slug>/code-review.claude-<model>.md still has an open item matching ❌ Open — continue until resolved'.
evals.expected_output: The agent finishes reporting (flips delivered findings to 📤 Reported) and stops. It does not edit source files and does not invoke code-gen.
expectations: No source file outside agent-spec/ is modified
The code-gen skill is not invoked
Both findings end the run as 📤 Reported in the tracker, not ❌ Open
The report still ends with the '🔄 REVIEW NEEDS FIXES' verdict line
